from collections import Counter, deque
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6d5b2da7.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    major = {c for c,n in counts.items() if c != bg and n >= 6}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Dense bounding boxes of a connected main-color object recover edge holes.
    boxes = []
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color not in major or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q = deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            density=len(cells)/area
            if area >= 4 and density >= 0.72:
                boxes.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,density))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==bg or v in major: continue
            near=Counter(grid[y][x] for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)) if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x] in major)
            if near and max(near.values()) >= 2:
                out[r][c]=near.most_common(1)[0][0]; continue
            candidates=[b for b in boxes if b[1]<=r<=b[2] and b[3]<=c<=b[4]]
            if candidates:
                # choose the smallest containing object; ties prefer a nearby color
                b=min(candidates,key=lambda z:((z[2]-z[1]+1)*(z[4]-z[3]+1), -(near.get(z[0],0))))
                out[r][c]=b[0]
            else:
                out[r][c]=bg
    return out
'''
